queries:
WITH account_stats AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN amount END) AS average_amount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN 1 END) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    average_amount,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count / (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) FROM account_stats) AS count_ratio
FROM account_stats
ORDER BY count_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH account_stats AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = a.account_id
       AND t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
    GROUP BY a.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    avg_amount,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count * 1.0 / (
        SELECT AVG(transaction_count) FROM account_stats
    ) AS count_ratio
FROM account_stats
WHERE transaction_count > 0
ORDER BY count_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH account_stats AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN amount END) AS average_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    average_amount,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count / (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) FROM account_stats) AS transaction_count_ratio
FROM account_stats
ORDER BY transaction_count_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH benchmark AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 FROM trans) /
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS avg_transactions_per_account
)
SELECT
    t.account_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS avg_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    COUNT(*) / b.avg_transactions_per_account AS transaction_count_ratio
FROM trans AS t
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
GROUP BY t.account_id
ORDER BY transaction_count_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
